name: Swiggy
tagline: India's No.2 food delivery app inside a multi-service convenience platform
facts: Sriharsha Majety MD & Group CEO; Rohit Kapoor, Food

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Elevate the quality of life of the urban consumer by offering unparalleled convenience.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: One app, one membership (Swiggy One) for food, groceries and dining out, unlocking the next 100M food users.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Value-led food growth: affordability formats like Toing and Bolt widen the funnel while profitable food funds Instamart.

strategy.label: FY31 targets
strategy.text: ₹2.5 lakh cr group GOV and ₹10,000 cr adj EBITDA; food ~₹5,000 cr EBITDA on 2.5-3.5x GOV.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Swiggy One cross-category membership, deep Bengaluru/South density and a shared fleet across food, Instamart and Dineout.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Should Swiggy fight Zomato for share in food, or accept No.2 and maximise cash for quick commerce?

customers.pain: Fee stacking and app prices above restaurant menus
customers.why: Swiggy One benefits across food, Instamart and Dineout; strong South India coverage

customers.pain: Regular food delivery feels too expensive for everyday meals
customers.why: Toing budget app and value menus; two of three Toing users are new

customers.who: 2.7 lakh partners, small eateries to chains
customers.pain: High commissions, unapproved discount campaigns, payout deductions
customers.why: Second large demand pool; dependence on one platform is risky

customers.pain: Unpredictable earnings, weather risk, delayed cash access
customers.why: Shared food and Instamart orders raise utilisation; Early Cashout instant payouts

customers.who: Couples and groups booking restaurants, events
customers.pain: Finding deals and tables at good restaurants
customers.why: Dineout discounts and Scenes events bundled with Swiggy One

products.name: Bolt
products.desc: 10-minute delivery from nearby restaurants for quick items

products.name: Toing
products.desc: Standalone budget food delivery app, live in 50 cities

products.name: Food on Train
products.desc: Meals delivered to train seats via IRCTC partnership

products.name: Swiggy Ads
products.desc: Sponsored listings and brand campaigns for restaurants

portfolio.north_star: Weekly food orders per active user delivered on time
portfolio.key_metrics: Food GOV, MTUs, frequency, AOV, adj EBITDA % GOV, Toing new-user share
portfolio.guardrails: Restaurant churn, cancellations, rider earnings per hour, complaint rate

products.name: Dineout
products.desc: Table reservations and bill-payment discounts at restaurants

products.name: Swiggy One
products.desc: Paid membership across food, Instamart and dining out

portfolio.north_star: Members transacting in two or more Swiggy services monthly
portfolio.key_metrics: OOH GOV (+44.8% YoY), membership penetration, cross-sell rate
portfolio.guardrails: Membership subsidy cost, restaurant discount fatigue

products.name: Instamart
products.desc: Quick commerce, 1,171 dark stores; covered in separate sheet

products.name: Partner apps
products.desc: Restaurant and delivery partner apps with payouts, analytics

portfolio.north_star: Shared fleet utilisation across food and quick commerce
portfolio.key_metrics: Orders per rider-hour, group adj EBITDA, consolidated GOV
portfolio.guardrails: Food margins not sacrificed to subsidise Instamart losses

rows.how: Percentage of order value plus payment and campaign charges
Platform fee (~₹14-15), delivery, packaging and surge fees
Membership fee for free delivery and discounts
Commission on discounted bills and ticket sales

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Group FY26 revenue ₹23,053 cr; Instamart now drives growth, food delivery drives profit.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Customers pay food and fees; restaurants pay commission and ads; riders paid per order from both.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Food adj EBITDA ₹292 cr (3.1% of GOV) vs Zomato 5.6%; scale and ad gap explain difference.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Toing affordability, Bolt speed, Swiggy One cross-sell, ad yield, Tier-2 expansion, Dineout profitability.

bullets.label: Capital
bullets.text: ₹10,000 cr QIP (Dec 2025) and Rapido stake exit gave ~₹14,400 cr cash runway.

friction: Same meal costs noticeably more than offline menu
Multiple fees revealed late at checkout
Instamart promos clutter the food ordering experience
Order issues resolved via slow chatbot refunds
Restaurants complain of unapproved discount deductions

competitors.label: Disruptors
competitors.text: Rapido Ownly zero-commission, Swish and Swish Go, Flipkart food

competitors.label: Direct ordering
competitors.text: QSR own apps, ONDC sellers, WhatsApp ordering

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Multi-service app, Swiggy One bundle, strong South India base

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Thin food margin, Instamart cash burn, restaurant revolt, gig regulation

news.label: Sep 2026
news.text: FSSAI action on Swiggy Instamart dark stores over food safety violations.

news.label: Aug 2026
news.text: Bengaluru restaurant boycott deferred after Swiggy agreed consent-based campaigns and refunds.

news.label: Jul 2026
news.text: Q1 FY27: loss narrows to ₹791 cr; food EBITDA up ₹100 cr YoY.

news.label: Watch
news.text: Can Toing grow new users without cannibalising Swiggy Food margins and restaurant trust?

sources: Swiggy Q1 FY27 press release, FY26 results, FY31 targets coverage, press reports 2025-26. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
